correctness.rationale: KKT threshold root on every polyhedral cell, explicit orthogonal-hyperplane Jacobian and absolute row sums, realization of every active support in strict cells, and exact exchange inequalities prove the global formula and quadratic reduction. Product-one sequence proves only an infimum, not attainment.

value.rationale: Gives a precise all-weight robustness budget for a widely used convex epigraph constraint, reduces exponential active-face enumeration to polynomial time, and exposes a motivated weight-design paradox (no nonexpansive finite cone, yet an infimum of one under fixed geometric mean). The exact planar phase has a golden-ratio mechanism and genuinely nonmonotone stability under imbalance. This geometric optimization is not simply a KKT derivative restatement; it provides interpretable stability and design boundaries.
